The Joint Seat Allocation Authority (JoSAA) 2026 has been set up by the Ministry of Education [erstwhile Ministry of Human Resources Development (MHRD)] to manage and regulate the joint seat allocation for admissions to 138 institutes for the academic year 2026-27. This includes 23 IITs, IISc Bengaluru, 31 NITs, IIEST Shibpur, 26 IIITs and 56 Other-Government Funded Technical Institutes (Other-GFTIs). Admission to all the academic programs offered by these Institutes will be made through a single platform.
Payment of partial admission fee (PAF) for NIT+ system has been extended up to 25.07.2026 (11 AM).

Important notice of NIT+ System

At the end of the fifth round of JoSAA 2026, candidates having a provisionally allocated seat (allocated in any round of JoSAA 2026 and which has not been cancelled or withdrawn) in NIT+ System are required to pay the Partial Admission Fee (PAF) in addition to the Seat Acceptance Fees from their JoSAA portal. The PAF MUST be paid from July 22, 2026 (10:00 AM) to July 24, 2026 (05:00 PM) (Please see Annexure 3 for the timeline). Non-payment of the partial admission fee will be treated as a rejection of the offered/allocated seat. Candidates are thus strongly advised to be vigilant and make the payment well within the stipulated time.
For CSAB 2026 Special Rounds and DASA 2026 (UG) for the NIT+ system, please visit https://csab.nic.in

Physical reporting at the allotted institute for candidates under the NIT+ system who have paid PAF and are not participating in CSAB 2026 Special Rounds and/or DASA 2026 (UG) will be conducted from August 13 -18, 2026.
